test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The position of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word POSITIVE is arranged in alphabetical order?
solution:
Given word: 'POSITIVE '

Now, arranging in alphabetical order:

 
 

 Letter
 P
 O
 S
 I
 T
 I
 V
 E
 
 

 Alphabetical order
 E
 I
 I
 O
 P
 S
 T
 V
 
 

 

So, after arranged in alphabetical order, there is no such letter will remain unchange.

Hence, the correct answer is **"None"**.
